_meta.description: Ukrainian unit-of-measure (UoM) raw OCR forms mapped to canonical units.
_meta.provenance: Raw forms come from OCR'd public procurement documents (Prozorro, Ukraine); labels were verified in a production data-quality campaign. The vocabulary section is a hand-curated mapping of common Ukrainian UoM spellings and abbreviations.
_meta.exact: raw_value → canonical target for rows of the production campaign mapping with confidence=high and a canonical target (duals, «невідомо» and new units excluded); answered by exact lookup, never by the model
_meta.rejudge2: v0.3.0: medium/low campaign forms promoted to high after an independent second LLM judge (gpt-5.5, blind to the first label) agreed with confidence=high; forms carrying an amount and unit/package duals never promoted
_meta.rows_note: production rows (form + product name + label + row count); labels: consensus of two independent LLM judges (gpt-5.5, gpt-4o) or high-confidence campaign labels; KEEP = leave as is
_meta.gold_note: data/gold.jsonl is held out BY FORM KEY from every source

_meta.description: Ukrainian unit-of-measure (UoM) raw OCR forms mapped to canonical units.
_meta.provenance: Raw forms come from OCR'd public procurement documents (Prozorro, Ukraine); labels were verified in a production data-quality campaign. The vocabulary section is a hand-curated mapping of common Ukrainian UoM spellings and abbreviations.
_meta.exact: raw_value → canonical target for rows of the production campaign mapping with confidence=high and a canonical target (duals, «невідомо» and new units excluded); answered by exact lookup, never by the model
_meta.rejudge2: v0.3.0: medium/low campaign forms promoted to high after an independent second LLM judge (gpt-5.5, blind to the first label) agreed with confidence=high; forms carrying an amount and unit/package duals never promoted
